name: Stable Diffusion 1.5
description: Stability AI - Classic diffusion model favoring dense, token-efficient prompts Ported verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer.
length_guidance: Stay under ~120 tokens (~90 words) while front-loading essential quality and scene descriptors.
detail_expectation: Pack quick-hit descriptors for subject, environment, lighting, and mood without wasting tokens.
avoid: Overly long sentences that exceed token budget
negative_prompt_default: ugly, tiling, poorly drawn, bad anatomy, deformed, blurry, low quality, watermark
few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Stable Diffusion 1.5-formatted prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details naturally into the prompt — do NOT echo them as a settings list at the end.

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
